title: Gal Gohan
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Miku Okazaki, a flashy, failing high school 'gal', asks young home economics teacher Shinji Yabe to help her bake cookies to win over her teachers. Her excitement leads Shinji to start a cooking club, where Miku is the only member. Each chapter teaches a dish while Miku flirts with Shinji, who tries to keep the line between teacher and student, and their relationship grows more romantic over ten volumes.
life_message: Effort and a skill learned with someone who believes in you can change how you see yourself.

content.note: 'Over the top' fan service, Miku removing her top or showing underwear (Otaku USA review); Ecchi genre, MangaDex suggestive; teen flirting with an adult teacher.

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Miku's reputation is teased, but she proves herself by achievement, not confrontation.

Order vs freedom.evidence: Gal fashion defies school dress norms; the story sides with her freedom.

Civic vs kin.evidence: Club and classmates matter; family barely appears.

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Teacher authority bends under familiarity; Shinji worries about the line.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Practical home economics and modern youth culture, no tradition.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Miku's look and enjoyment of life are celebrated.

folkways.japan: The gyaru subculture rebels against school uniform norms, and club activities with a teacher adviser are standard Japanese school life.
